verses.text: Israel packed up everything and reached Beersheba. There he offered sacrifices to the God his father Isaac worshiped. Before Egypt, he paused to honor God. 🙏
That night God spoke to Israel in a vision: “Jacob, Jacob!” He answered, “I’m here.” 👂
God said, “I am God—the God your father worshiped. Don’t be afraid to go down to Egypt. I’ll make you into a great nation there.” The move had God’s promise on it. ✨
“I’ll go down to Egypt with you, and I’ll surely bring you back up again. Joseph will be there when you die.” God spoke to the whole journey ahead. 🕊️
Jacob set out from Beersheba. His sons carried him, the children, and their wives in the wagons Pharaoh had sent. The whole family was moving together. 🛞
They took their livestock and all the property they’d gained in Canaan, then came to Egypt: Jacob and every descendant with him. Nothing was left behind. 🧳
His sons, grandsons, daughters, and granddaughters all came with him. Jacob brought his whole family down to Egypt. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
Here are the names of Israel’s children who came to Egypt with Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn. The family record begins. 📜
Reuben’s sons were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. Every name matters in this family line. 🧾
Simeon’s sons were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul—the son of a Canaanite woman. These were Simeon’s descendants. 📜
Levi’s sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. 🧾
Judah’s sons were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; Er and Onan had died in Canaan. Perez’s sons were Hezron and Hamul. The record keeps both the family and its losses. 🕯️
Issachar’s sons were Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron. 🧾
Zebulun’s sons were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel. 📜
These were Leah’s children, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, along with his daughter Dinah. The total of Leah’s sons and daughters was thirty-three. 🔢
Gad’s sons were Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli. 🧾
Asher’s sons were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah; their sister was Serah. Beriah’s sons were Heber and Malchiel. 📜
These were the children of Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah. She bore them to Jacob, sixteen people in all. 🔢
Rachel, Jacob’s wife, had two sons: Joseph and Benjamin. 💛
In Egypt, Joseph’s wife Asenath—the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On—bore him Manasseh and Ephraim. The family grew in Egypt too. 👶
Benjamin’s sons were Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard. Each name carries the family line forward. 📜
These were Rachel’s descendants born to Jacob: fourteen people in all. 🔢
Dan’s son was Hushim. 🧾
Naphtali’s sons were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem. 📜
These were the children of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel. She bore them to Jacob, seven people in all. 🔢
The direct descendants who came with Jacob to Egypt—excluding his sons’ wives—numbered sixty-six. The count is carefully stated. 🔢
Joseph had two sons born in Egypt. Everyone in Jacob’s household who came to Egypt numbered seventy. The family arrived as one people. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
Jacob sent Judah ahead to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. Then the family arrived in Goshen. 🧭
Joseph got his chariot ready and went to meet his father Israel in Goshen. When they met, Joseph fell on his father’s neck and wept for a long time. Years apart, all that emotion came out. 😭
Israel said to Joseph, “Now I can die, since I’ve seen your face and know you’re still alive.” His heart was finally at rest. 🥹

Joseph told his brothers and his father’s household, “I’ll go speak to Pharaoh and tell him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household, who lived in Canaan, have come to me.’” He would handle the introduction. 🏛️
“These men are shepherds; they’ve always cared for livestock. They’ve brought their flocks, herds, and everything they own.” Joseph prepared Pharaoh for the full picture. 🐑
“When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, ‘What work do you do?’” Joseph was getting them ready for the question. 💬

“Answer, ‘Your servants have cared for livestock from our youth until now—we and our fathers too.’ Then you can live in Goshen, because Egyptians consider shepherds detestable.” Joseph gave them a clear way to settle together. 🏠
